statusText: EA_ON / green: NQ remains closed; Tail is low while geopolitical, rates and policy uncertainty keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; the Sunday Globex reopening remains the principal structural checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress ahead of NQ reopening
body: NQ is closed, so no live one-way price path is observable. U.S.-China talks continue without a verified outcome at the cutoff; Iran/Houthi escalation and weaker Gulf equities raise reopening uncertainty. Fresh supplementary Finviz context shows positive semiconductors but split megacaps, not live NQ structure.

forecast.analysis: As the reopening approaches, conditional gap risk rises; Tail remains below WATCH unless later trading shows shallow pullbacks, failed retracements, repeated extension, or aligned cross-asset stress.
If weekend headlines stay contained, Friday's high-yield and crude backdrop should keep Stress extreme while Tail remains low ahead of live price discovery.

forecast.analysis: With roughly two hours to reopening, headline sensitivity is high; Tail stays low unless new information materially raises the odds of a persistent one-way opening path.
If no fresh geopolitical or policy discontinuity appears, the final pre-open hour should remain extreme-Stress but below WATCH because opening structure is still unobserved.
drivers: Policy and security headlines remain active

forecast.analysis: At Globex reopen, a large aligned gap plus a shallow or failed first retracement would support WATCH; orderly two-way trade would argue against escalation.

forecast.analysis: If the first post-open hour shows repeated extension with weak retracements, WATCH can persist; a meaningful pullback would weaken the Tail case.
If two-way discovery develops by the second post-open hour, Tail should ease within WATCH; failed pullbacks or extreme holding would keep the danger window active.
If the reopening gap is meaningfully retraced and cross-assets stabilize, the base case returns below WATCH; one-way extension would invalidate that normalization.
If overnight trading remains two-way, Tail should ease while Stress stays extreme because geopolitical and rate-sensitive risks remain unresolved.
If no delayed second leg emerges, Tail should remain below WATCH; renewed extension after a failed pullback is the main re-escalation trigger.
If rotation replaces directional extension, Tail should stay low as the reopening shock decays, while headline-driven Stress remains extreme.
If price discovery stays orderly into Europe, low Tail remains the base case; a fresh energy or security shock would mainly raise Stress unless price aligns.
If overnight retracements remain meaningful, mean-reversion failure should stay unconfirmed despite the elevated oil and rates backdrop.
If European participation does not reinforce one direction, Tail should stay low; directional breadth plus shallow pullbacks would be the contrary signal.
If Europe brings cross-asset divergence rather than alignment, Stress can stay elevated while Tail remains low.
If Europe develops directional efficiency with shallow retracements, conditional Tail rises modestly; otherwise two-way structure keeps it low.
A scheduled Fed speech at 10:30 UTC is a policy checkpoint. Tail should stay low unless any repricing aligns with persistent NQ direction and weak retracements.
If no new catalyst aligns with persistent direction, Tail should stay low as U.S. premarket liquidity improves; Stress remains extreme.
CFNAI at 12:30 UTC adds a data checkpoint before cash open; Tail stays below WATCH unless the release coincides with directional NQ efficiency and weak retracements.
drivers: Chicago Fed National Activity Index at 12:30 UTC

forecast.analysis: If pre-open NQ remains balanced, Tail should stay below WATCH into the cash open; shallow opening pullbacks plus repeated extension would raise Tail.
If the first cash-session hour develops two-way auction and meaningful pullbacks, Tail should stay low; persistent opening continuation would be the adverse structure.
If the second cash-session hour remains rotational, Tail should stay low; continued one-way extension after failed pullbacks would be the principal adverse signal.
If the U.S. midday session remains rotational with meaningful retracements, Tail should stay low; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the contrary signal.

At reopening, WATCH is conditional on a large aligned gap plus weak or failed retracements.
